name: Diminish Resistance
levelText: arcanist 2, bard 2, cleric 2, inquisitor 2, magus 2, mesmerist 2, oracle 2, psychic 2, skald 2, sorcerer 2, warpriest 2, witch 2, wizard 2
componentsText: V, S, M/DF (a pinch of coarse sand)
description: You weaken a creature’s resistance against one energy type you select: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The creature’s resistance to that energy type decreases by 5 (minimum 0), plus an additional 5 for every 5 caster levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of 20 at 18th level).
